locationExplanations.foreground: KUDY uses your location on this device to show where you are and to play the right story when you reach a stop.
locationExplanations.background: During an active walk KUDY needs location in the background so stories trigger while your phone stays in your pocket. Coordinates never leave this device.

locationForegroundService.notificationBody: Location stays on so guide stories play at the right places.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: KUDY uses location locally to trigger the selected guide.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: KUDY uses location during an active walk; coordinates stay on this device.
